title: Getting started
intro: A look at how this installation is set up. Nothing here changes anything; each line says where to act.
envNote: Server settings (public address, secure cookies, the key that encrypts secrets) are set with environment variables, as in the example compose file.
state.not_configured: not set up on this machine
twofa.on: Two-factor authentication is on for your account.
twofa.off: Turn on two-factor authentication for your account and keep the backup codes.
https.off: You reach Armadok without HTTPS. Put it behind a reverse proxy that serves HTTPS before using it for real.
cookie.off: Cookies are not marked secure (ARMADOK_COOKIE_SECURE is off). Turn it on once you use HTTPS.
key.on: A key encrypts the secrets stored in the database. Keep a backup of it.
key.off: No encryption key is set: secrets cannot be stored. Set ARMADOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
dns.on: A DNS provider account is set up.
dns.off: Add a DNS provider account so new sites get their record.
notify.on: A notification channel is set up.
notify.off: Add a notification channel to hear about problems when you are not looking.
proxy.restricted: The proxy whose forwarded addresses are trusted is set.
proxy.any: Every sender is trusted for forwarded addresses (UVICORN_FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS is *): name your proxy instead.
proxy.none: Behind a reverse proxy, set UVICORN_FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS so visitors' real addresses are seen.
